title: when your paragraph has that obvious AI voice

product_understanding.user_pain: Students and writers are unsure which parts of a draft sound AI-heavy or robotic.
product_understanding.feature: Clearfy AI detector highlights likely AI-written wording and the humanizer helps revise stiff text with adjustable strength.
product_understanding.result: User can see what to edit and revise the draft more intentionally.
product_understanding.emotional_angle: last-minute relief without pretending the tool writes the paper for them

script_lines: so you are telling me I fixed my sources but my paragraph still sounds robotic...
that this website has a humanizer for that...
choose how strong you want the rewrite
no cuz the modes make this so much easier to edit...
not writing for you, just helping the draft sound less stiff
safety_notes: Avoid claims about bypassing AI detectors.
Do not promise guaranteed human score or academic success.
Frame Clearfy as checking and editing support.
